line.note: Positions as printed in IMO MSC.73(69) para 3.3.1 (1998 datum, about 0.1' east of WGS 84; no official WGS 84 version).

points.name: Karang Galang Lt
points.rep: Entering, abeam (para 3.3.2). MPA: VTIS East CH 10 (sector 9).

points.name: Pulau Jangkat Beacon
points.rep: Entering, abeam (para 3.3.2). MPA: VTIS West CH 73 (sector 7).

points.name: Eastern Buoy
points.rep: Entering, abeam (para 3.3.2). MPA: VTIS East CH 10 (sector 9).

points.name: Horsburgh Lighthouse
points.rep: IMO para 3.3.3 lists it as a reference point; MPA (Confirmation of Arrival / VTIS East CH 10) asks vessels from the east to report when Horsburgh Lt is abeam. The IMO entry trigger from the east is the eastern limit 104°23'E (para 2.1 and 3.3.1).

points.name: Pulau Iyu Kechil (abeam point)
points.rep: MPA Confirmation of Arrival: VTIS West CH 73 when Pulau Iyu Kechil is abeam. In the IMO text it is a reference point only (para 3.3.3); the IMO entry line from the west is Tg Piai to P. Karimun Kecil.

bgs.name: Eastern Boarding Ground A
bgs.use: Arriving vessels (PC 14/2015 description: non-tankers from east or west bound for eastern or western sector, or as Port Master directs; SPI 2025 gives position only).

bgs.name: Eastern Boarding Ground B
bgs.use: All tankers picking up pilots in the eastern sector.

bgs.name: Eastern Boarding Ground C
bgs.use: Vessels arriving from the east bound for the eastern or western sector, or as directed by the Port Master.

bgs.name: Southern Boarding Ground
bgs.use: SE of Sebarok Beacon; only by prior arrangement with Port Operations Control Centre.

bgs.name: Western Boarding Ground B
bgs.use: Chemical and gas carriers bound for ASSPU anchorage and facilities on the western side of Singapore.

bgs.name: East Johor Strait Boarding Ground
bgs.use: SE of Eastern Buoy; East Johor Strait.

bgs.name: Gusong Boarding Ground
bgs.use: Vessels from the east calling at Sudong Sector anchorages or Raffles Reserved Anchorage, with prior Port Master permission.
